review.notes: Full review of README, Suggested.lean and the 7 companion Lean files. Gate FAILS (blob 7, sorry-data 5, imports 1, mathlib-subimports 1; re-run agrees). Depcheck: 238 roadmaps, 2345 edges, 0 problems, but this misses the main-to-main ReductiveGroups/ReductiveGroupsPartII loop (README 692, 716, 839, 1077), which the PR's own 3-line edit only partly cut; FormalConnectionsOpers and InverseGalois are also two-way suppliers. Seeded sample: 'Supplier:' resolves to RG2.3.7, and Milne iAG Prop. 27.54 (p. 487) and Cor. 27.55 (p. 488) support it; the 'Cross-cutting prerequisite' has no owner (SchemeAndStackFoundations L1 and the pins own it). Suggested.lean elaborates with only sorry warnings; #check pass done; it states no headline (maximal-torus conjugacy probe elaborates at the pins); 45 sorry'd data definitions across the Lean files. README restates eleven results Tau Ceti proves at the pin. Layer 3 connectedness claim is refuted by milne-iag lines 785-786, 821-824, 3734-3738. Also checked: Dudas-Michel 8.7/8.9/9.6/10.1 and Conrad-Feng 12.3.1/H.1 locators; 27-row adversarial table; ownership against 5 closest open roadmaps.
